feeds.title: 9jafoods » Weight loss
feeds.description: Hey, my name is Odiraa. 9jaFood is a platform where you will learn much about Nigerian dishes and those of other nations that you can devour and enjoy. We will publish recipes and also show in the video how this is done. It is a place where persons who want to master the art of cooking can come and learn tricks that will help them take hold of their hearts. Our food considers the health of the individual and as such, we make sure that we add nutritional information about every item we introduce.

feeds.title: Lose It Nigerian Blog
feeds.description: I am Ronke Edoho. I am also a Certified Nutrition and Clinical Weight Loss specialist and the author of the Lose It Nigerian (LIN) books and plans. I created Lose It Nigerian to help anyone trying to balance weight loss and a love of delicious Nigerian food. LIN is full of delicious healthy recipes. Each plan is carefully designed and tested to ensure the best result.

feeds.title: Qilo Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest insight into proper nutrition to help you lose or maintain your weight. From recipes to exercise advice. Experience a more exciting, sustainable, and clinically backed way to lose weight and stay healthy. Lose, manage, and maintain a healthy weight and lifestyle one activity at a time, while enjoying the freedom of living a normal life, eating what you love, and developing healthy habits that last under the supervision of weight loss experts.
